items.title: Brooklyn building collapse death toll rises to eight
items.feedTitle: Casualties continue to rise after Brooklyn building collapses
items.summary: A three-story apartment building in Brooklyn collapsed, killing at least eight people, including two children, with dozens injured. First responders continue searching for survivors among the rubble. The cause of the collapse remains under investigation.

items.title: Gunman kills one, wounds four at DC gym before dying
items.feedTitle: Gunman dead after killing 1, injuring 4 in mass shooting at gym in DC's Logan Circle
items.summary: A shooting at VIDA Fitness gym in Washington DC's Logan Circle killed one person and injured four others. The suspected gunman died by suicide after the incident. Police say the shooter had a dispute with the building's homeowners association.

items.title: House approves veterans compensation bill with bipartisan support
items.feedTitle: House approves bill to boost compensation for many veterans, with some floor drama
items.summary: The House passed legislation to boost compensation for approximately 58,000 medically retired combat veterans. Though the objective has broad bipartisan backing, lawmakers and veterans groups disagree on implementation details.

items.title: Trump warns of migrant caravans marching through Mexico
items.feedTitle: Trump: ‘Huge CARAVANS are … beginning illegal march through Mexico’
items.summary: President Trump posted warnings on social media about migrant caravans reportedly beginning their march through Mexico toward the U.S. border. Trump threatened to double tariffs on Mexico if it does not halt the migrants.

items.title: U.S. envoys conclude Ukraine talks, meet with Zelenskyy
items.feedTitle: U.S. envoys meet with Putin in Moscow on Ukraine talks, then head for Dublin to see Zelenskyy
items.summary: White House envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met with Russian President Putin in Moscow for approximately two hours to discuss Ukraine peace talks, then traveled to Dublin to meet with President Zelenskyy. No major breakthrough emerged from the talks.

stlouis.title: Students, teacher injured in Blackhawk Middle School stabbing
stlouis.feedTitle: Students, teacher injured after stabbing at Blackhawk Middle School, police say
stlouis.summary: A stabbing incident at Blackhawk Middle School in the St. Louis metro area left multiple students and a teacher injured. Police responded to the scene and are investigating the circumstances of the attack.

stlouis.title: Nine St. Louis public schools to close
stlouis.feedTitle: Nine St. Louis public schools to close
stlouis.summary: Nine schools within the St. Louis public school system are set to close. The district cited operational and budgetary considerations for the closures.

stlouis.title: East-West Gateway unveils regional economic initiative
stlouis.feedTitle: East-West Gateway, Greater St. Louis Inc. unveil initiative to chart region's future
stlouis.summary: East-West Gateway and Greater St. Louis Inc. announced a joint initiative to chart the future direction of the St. Louis region's economic development and growth strategy.

items.title: US envoys meet Putin, agree to include Europe in Ukraine talks
items.feedTitle: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
items.summary: American envoys concluded talks with Russian President Putin in Moscow, where Putin agreed to allow European negotiators to join the next round of Ukraine peace discussions. The talks marked continued U.S.-mediated efforts to address the nearly five-year conflict.

items.title: Israeli airstrike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians
items.feedTitle: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
items.summary: An Israeli airstrike on Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza killed six people, including a surgeon, and wounded 28 others, according to hospital officials. The strike targeted a building containing surgical wards and intensive care units at one of Gaza's last functioning major medical facilities.

items.title: Iran threatens to strike U.S. bases in Europe if attacked
items.feedTitle: Rezaei to Al Mayadeen: Iran Will Strike Distant US Bases if Attacked
items.summary: Iran's top security official warned that Tehran would strike American military bases beyond the Persian Gulf, including in Europe, if the United States resumes air strikes. The threat came amid ongoing tensions and reports of Israeli preparations for possible military action against Iran.

items.title: Spain approves housing reforms after nationwide general strike
items.feedTitle: Spain: Housing crisis prompts first general strike in 14 years, before hundreds of thousands join protest
items.summary: Spain's parliament passed new laws limiting evictions following the country's first general strike in 14 years over housing costs and affordability. The outcome of the measures depends on the results of an upcoming snap election.

items.title: Indonesia vice president resigns amid eligibility disputes
items.feedTitle: Indonesia vice president resigns amid dispute over eligibility
items.summary: Indonesia's Vice President resigned as his eligibility and academic credentials came under scrutiny, amid a broader political alliance breakdown. The resignation comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces growing rifts with his predecessor.

items.title: India records 38% decline in TB mortality since 2015
items.feedTitle: India Records 38% Decline in TB Mortality, 94% Treatment Success Rate: WHO Report
items.summary: The World Health Organization's Global Tuberculosis Report 2026 shows India achieved a 38% reduction in TB mortality since 2015, with a 94% treatment success rate. India remains among the top eight countries for TB cases globally but has made significant progress in combating the disease.

items.title: Agricultural sector grows over 4% annually for first time
items.feedTitle: Agri sector grew over 4% annually for first time since Independence; 50 cr people overcome poverty: PM Modi
items.summary: Prime Minister Modi announced that India's agricultural sector achieved over 4% annual growth for the first time since Independence. The milestone reflects improved productivity and policy reforms in the farming sector.

items.title: ReNew to invest ₹80,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh green projects
items.feedTitle: Vizag CII Summit: ReNew to invest ₹80,000 crore in green data centre, solar manufacturing in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: ReNew announced massive investments totaling ₹80,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh, including a ₹67,000-crore green hyperscale data center, polysilicon and metallurgical silicon manufacturing facilities, and permanent magnet production. The projects are expected to create significant employment opportunities in the state.

items.title: Major gold heist at Tanishq jewellery showroom in Madurai
items.feedTitle: Major gold heist at Tanishq jewellery showroom in Madurai
items.summary: A significant gold theft occurred at a recently opened TATA Tanishq showroom in Madurai on Wednesday night. The heist is under investigation by local authorities.

items.title: IIT Kharagpur introduces first postgraduate medical courses
items.feedTitle: IIT Kharagpur becomes first IIT to introduce postgraduate medical courses
items.summary: IIT Kharagpur became the first Indian Institute of Technology to introduce postgraduate medical courses, receiving approval from the National Medical Commission. The program will offer six MD seats in various medical specializations.

immigration.title: DHS proposes stricter H-1B extension review rule; comments close Nov 13
immigration.feedTitle: DHS wants every H-1B extension reviewed from scratch; the rule is only proposed and comments close November 13
immigration.summary: The Department of Homeland Security has proposed a rule eliminating USCIS deference to prior H-1B approvals, requiring every extension to be reviewed from scratch. This proposed change, not yet finalized, could affect approximately 208,000 work visa renewals and generate thousands of additional requests for evidence. Public comment period closes November 13.

immigration.title: IBM ends H-1B and green card sponsorship for most consulting roles
immigration.feedTitle: IBM to end H-1B visa and green card sponsorship for most consulting roles amid Trump's immigration crackdown — Report
immigration.summary: IBM announced it will end H-1B visa and green card sponsorship for the majority of its consulting division roles by end of 2026, citing availability of U.S. talent. The decision is finalized and in effect, likely affecting Indian IT workers significantly.

immigration.title: USCIS ends automatic EAD extension practice for renewal applicants
immigration.feedTitle: Removal of Automatic Extensions for Certain Employment Authorization Documents
immigration.summary: The Department of Homeland Security published an interim final rule on October 30 ending the automatic extension of employment authorization documents for aliens who have timely filed EAD renewal applications. The rule is finalized and in effect, eliminating the prior practice of extending work permits by up to 540 days during processing.

items.title: U.S. existing home sales hit 16-year low in October
items.feedTitle: Home sales hit 16-year low in October amid record-high mortgage rates
items.summary: Sales of existing U.S. homes plummeted to 3.75 million units in October, down 8.8% year-over-year and the lowest level since 2010. Buyers were deterred by record-high mortgage rates and persistent inflation, signaling continued weakness in the residential real estate market.

items.title: Indian markets extend winning streak with FII inflows
items.feedTitle: Nov. 12: Sensex, Nifty extend winning streak to third session; broader markets outperform
items.summary: India's Sensex and Nifty indices extended gains for a third consecutive session, with the Sensex closing above 81,900. Realty stocks surged 4.5%, and foreign institutional investor inflows of $6.43 billion in November supported the rally, though some sectors like IT and auto lagged.

items.title: U.S. inflation rose 0.4% in October as prices cool
items.feedTitle: US inflation rose 0.4% in October as price increases cooled and gas costs dipped
items.summary: U.S. inflation increased 0.4% from September to October, slightly above expectations but representing a cooldown in price increases as gas costs dipped. The moderation in inflation comes after Republicans' electoral losses, which analysts attributed partly to voter concerns over high prices.

finance.note: Oil prices fell to lows not seen since August as President Trump signaled the Iran conflict is 'effectively over,' reducing geopolitical risk. U.S. stocks declined as Nvidia's leadership implosion sent shockwaves through the AI sector—the company's $888 billion market cap destruction this week dragged the S&P 500 and Nasdaq lower despite gains in alternative chip makers like AMD. Watch: whether Nvidia can stabilize under interim CEO Colette Kress, whether the DHS H-1B deference rule becomes final on November 13, and whether energy markets sustainably break the $90 Brent level.

cards.title: The Sunk Cost Fallacy in Crisis
cards.insight: When Nvidia's board moved to oust Jensen Huang, they faced pressure to 'save' his $10 billion Anthropic pledge. The board's job was not to protect past commitments but to protect shareholder value going forward. Past decisions create anchors that distort present judgment.
cards.takeaway: In your own decisions, separate what you've already committed from what the data tells you to do now. Yesterday's bet does not obligate tomorrow's bet.

cards.title: Consensus Disguises Risk
cards.insight: Nvidia's scandal reveals how concentrated faith in a single leader can mask fragility. The market treated Huang's judgment as infallible; his personal misconduct didn't change his technical acumen, but it did expose how much risk had been hidden in the assumption he was irreplaceable.
cards.takeaway: When everyone agrees on a person or a bet, ask what single point of failure you're accepting. Consensus often means risk is underpriced, not that it's gone.

cards.title: Reversibility Changes Everything
cards.insight: IBM's decision to end H-1B sponsorship is nearly irreversible in the short term—once talent leaves or is not hired, it's hard to rebuild teams. Decisions with long lead times and high friction deserve more scrutiny than those you can unwind.
cards.takeaway: Before committing resources or people to a path, assess: Can I reverse this if I learn I was wrong? If not, the threshold for certainty should be higher.

cards.title: Regulatory Lag Distorts Real Conditions
cards.insight: The proposed H-1B deference rule won't become final until well into 2026 or later, yet companies are already making hiring and retention decisions as if it were law. The uncertainty itself becomes the constraint, not the rule.
cards.takeaway: When facing regulatory uncertainty, don't wait for finality. Model scenarios, communicate ranges, and decide on the most likely path—then build reversibility into your plans.

ai.title: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic sued to halt frontier AI development
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic hit with lawsuit seeking halt to frontier AI development
ai.summary: A lawsuit was filed against OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic seeking to halt their frontier AI development efforts. The legal challenge raises questions about the pace and oversight of advanced AI model development by the industry's leading players.

ai.title: OpenAI raises $15B at $1.25 trillion valuation
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI raises $15B at a $1.25T valuation, sources say. What it means for the IPO
ai.summary: OpenAI raised $15 billion in new funding at a valuation of $1.25 trillion, according to sources. The funding round underscores investor confidence in the company's dominance in generative AI despite competitive pressures from rivals.

ai.title: Anthropic launches Claude for Manufacturing ahead of IPO
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic IPO: Claude maker to begin trading on Thursday, Nov. 19
ai.summary: Anthropic launched Claude for Manufacturing, a specialized AI tool for industrial applications, as the company prepares for its initial public offering on November 19. The product launch demonstrates Anthropic's expansion beyond general-purpose AI into vertical-specific solutions.

ai.title: Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress on scandal
ai.feedTitle: Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress
ai.summary: Nvidia's ousted CEO Jensen Huang agreed to testify before Congress following allegations of affairs, including one with a woman suspected of spying for China. His testimony is expected to address national security concerns and potential vulnerabilities in the U.S. AI industry.

ai.title: UK's Fractile raises $720M to challenge Nvidia's AI chip dominance
ai.feedTitle: UK's Fractile Raises $720M to Challenge Nvidia's AI Chips
ai.summary: British AI chip startup Fractile raised $720 million in funding to develop purpose-built processors competing with Nvidia's dominance in the AI infrastructure market. The funding positions Fractile as one of the top-funded players in the alternative AI chip race.
